Name: Dungeon Secrets
Author: Mulaag53
Description:
[size=5][b]DUNGEON SECRETS[/b][/size][i]Those boarded-up doorways in the Mines were never just decoration.[/i] Every so often a mine floor has a doorway that's been nailed shut or buried under a cave-in. In vanilla you just walk past them. Now they give way to a bomb. Blow one open and the rubble comes tumbling out. Behind it is a small, forgotten chamber: maybe a vein of ore, maybe a seam of coal, maybe a cache the old miners left behind. There's always a way down in the middle, so a secret room never costs you progress. [size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Any explosive works.[/b] A cherry bomb, bomb or mega bomb opens the doorway if the blast reaches it. [/*]
[*][b]Every doorway spills 50 stone[/b] (adjustable in config.json). [/*]
[*][b]What's behind it is rolled the moment it blows[/b], from how deep you are and the bomber's luck (daily luck and any luck buffs):
[list]
[*][b]Ore vein:[/b] the floor's ore with a little of the tier below it, plus the odd gem or geode node. Deep floors can roll diamond and mystic stones, and in Skull Cavern the share of iridium grows the deeper you go. [/*]
[*][b]Coal seam:[/b] coal nodes, plus a few geode nodes. [/*]
[*][b]Miners' cache:[/b] one to three treasure chests of ore, bars, gems, geodes and bombs to suit the floor. [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Step through[/b] by interacting with the opened doorway. It's a tight squeeze, and there's no squeezing back out. [/*]
[*][b]The chamber[/b] is a small room built from the floor's own tiles, so it matches wherever you found it, from the brown upper Mines to the ice floors, the lava floors and the Skull Cavern sandstone. [/*]
[*][b]The only way out is down:[/b] a ladder in the middle of the room, or in Skull Cavern a shaft that drops you several floors, just like the vanilla ones. [/*]
[*][b]Old workrooms.[/b] Doorways with minecart tracks running into them lead to an abandoned miners' workroom. A working furnace and workbench stand against the back wall (bolted down, so they can't be taken), next to a chest of leftover supplies. The tracks run right up to the ladder. [/*]
[*][b]The occasional lantern[/b] still hangs on the wall and lights the room. The room takes the lighting of the floor you came from, so on dark floors the lanterns are the only light. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Balance[/b][/size] The goal is a nice find, not a jackpot. Veins hold 4 to 18 nodes, which break with your pickaxe like any others. Caches use modest stacks scaled to the floor, and there are no prismatic shards or other rare-only items in the loot tables. Luck nudges the odds of a cache and the size of a vein; it doesn't break them. [size=4][b]Where the doorways are[/b][/size] There are two kinds: the [b]boarded door[/b] (leads to a plain chamber) and the [b]caved-in shaft entrance with tracks[/b] (leads to a workroom). They appear on these floors:
[list]
[*]Mines 1-39 and 80-119: both kinds [/*]
[*]Mines 40-69 (ice): boarded doors only [/*]
[*]Skull Cavern: shaft entrances, plus both kinds on dinosaur floors [/*]
[*]The dangerous mines from Qi's challenge: both kinds, except on the ice floors [/*]
[/list]On some floors (dark ice, dark Skull Cavern and slime floors) the game draws the same spots as signs, ice or brick, so those aren't openable. Floor 120 and the Quarry Mine are left alone. [size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Unzip the download into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. [/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI. [/*]
[/list]To uninstall, delete the [i]Dungeon Secrets[/i] folder. Nothing is added to your save. [size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]StoneYield[/b] (default 50): stone spilled by each blasted doorway. Set it in config.json, which is created the first time you run the game with the mod. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley Expanded. [/*]
[*]Doorways are found by the game's own mine tiles. Mods that replace the mine maps can change which doorways appear. [/*]
[*]The opened-doorway art and the chamber are built from the vanilla mine tilesheets. With a mine recolor installed, an opened doorway may not quite match its surroundings. [/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] the private chamber is single-player only. In multiplayer, a blown doorway spills its spoils on the spot and opens a ladder (or a shaft in Skull Cavern) right there. Multiplayer is untested so far. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Console commands (for testing)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]dsec_list[/b]: lists the blocked doorways on the current floor [/*]
[*][b]dsec_open[/b] [i][ore|coal|treasure][/i]: opens every doorway on the floor as if bombed; the optional word forces the room type [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size] Mod by Mulaag. All art is built from Stardew Valley's own mine tiles. Dungeon Secrets is a fan-made mod and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ConcernedApe. Bug reports and ideas are very welcome. Please include your SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]) and the floor you were on.

Manifest.Description: Blow open the boarded and caved-in doorways in the Mines and Skull Cavern. Every one spills stone; behind it is a small chamber with an ore vein, a coal seam or a miners' cache, and a way down.
